type each item and response in an overseer review round file

Usage: overseer-judge review [OPTIONS] <path|->

Arguments:
  <path|->  Review round file; - reads stdin

Options:
      --pretty[=<PRETTY>]    Indent JSON output
      --dry-run[=<DRY_RUN>]  Print the request that would be sent and exit 0
      --model <name>         Jev model (default from TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL)
      --timeout <duration>   Timeout for each HTTP attempt; 0 or negative disables it [default: 10s]
      --log-level <level>    Stderr diagnostics [default: warn] [possible values: debug, info, warn, error]
  -h, --help                 Print help
  -V, --version              Print version

Output: JSON Lines, one object per item: id, severity, status, style_only, responses, model, usage, warnings. --pretty is rejected: a record stays on one line. A file with content and no items is a usage error (exit 2).

Example:
  overseer-judge review .overseer/review/round-4.md |
    jq -c 'select(.style_only > 0.5)'
